claims.content: Users can use PeaZip for decompressing the contents of a selected (by them) compressed archive and extract them in a folder.

goal.raw_text: Users can use PeaZip for decompressing the contents of a selected (by them) compressed archive and extract them in a folder.

claims.content: User
The selected archive is of one of the supported for extraction by PeaZip formats.
In case the selected archive is encrypted, user must know and insert password and (if there is one) keyfile in order to have access to the archives contents.

The User initiates the use case by selecting one or more archives and either pressing the "Extract" button in the toolbar, selecting "Go to extraction layout" from the "Browser" submenu, right-clicking the selection to choose "Extract", or using the context menu's "Send to" option to select "Extract".

trigger.raw_text: The User initiates the use case by selecting one or more archives and either pressing the "Extract" button in the toolbar, selecting "Go to extraction layout" from the "Browser" submenu, right-clicking the selection to choose "Extract", or using the context menu's "Send to" option to select "Extract".

claims.content: The Decompression/Extraction function is set off and defined in the extraction window (also referred to as extraction interface).
User selects one or more archives that have suitable format for decompression and extraction of their content from file manager interface.
User presses the button writing “Extract” on it, from the toolbar — this is the icon shown with label “Extract”.
Alternatively, User may press the button writing “Browser” on it in file manager interface and then select “Go to extraction layout” from the submenu that appears.
Alternatively, User may right-click the selected archive(s) in file manager interface and choose “Extract” or “Extract(in new folder)” from the context menu.
Alternatively, User may select archive(s) outside the application’s graphical environment, right-click, and choose “Extract”, “Extract here”, or “Extract here(in new folder)” from the “Send to” menu.
PeaZip decompresses the contents of the selected archive and extracts them into a folder chosen by the user.
The original archive retains its content and name and remains saved at the same place it was initially stored; it is neither destroyed, deleted, nor left empty.
User may use the Drag and Drop Feature to initiate extraction by dragging selected archive(s) to a target folder or interface area.
If the archive is encrypted, User must provide Password and/or Keyfile Use via the Password and Keyfile Use interface before extraction can proceed.
User may access Computer System Management Tools or File Management Utilities through the File Manager Interface to navigate or prepare locations for extraction.
User may alter Object Selection/View Mode Alternation to change how files are displayed prior to selecting archives for extraction.
User may browse Computer System’s Locations via the File Manager Interface to locate archives stored on different drives or directories before initiating extraction.
Graphic display of currently executed functions provides real-time feedback during extraction, allowing User to monitor progress or cancel if needed.
If the selected archive is encrypted and the user does not know or insert the correct password (and keyfile if required), access to the archive’s contents will be denied.
